name: partsig
parts: part p_name trigram signatures: U64 sig, one per stored part row: bit tri_hash(a, b, c) is set for every three consecutive bytes a, b, c of the row's p_name; all ones when the name has a non-ASCII byte (otherwise the name is ASCII)

layout.summary: storage custpart (customer, part; its 50 parts linked unchanged) followed by part 50: U64 sig with one 64-bit signature per stored (= canonical) part row, sig[c] covering every byte trigram of p_name of row c (bit = top 6 bits of the 32-bit Knuth multiplicative hash of the 24-bit trigram value)
layout.units: sig: bit set of trigram hash positions 0..64, one u64 per part row
